interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to SYSTEM FRICTION INSTITUTE through its authenticated, scope-bound MCP gateway and owner-scoped Studio MCP. The contract exposes persisted World state plus a bounded World daily cycle, observation, proposal, authorized execution, governance decision, bounded ROOT operations, Cases, Method Lab and Studio capabilities. Effective authority remains user-, tenant- and scope-bound.
